title: District Level Carbon Baseline Analysis and Pathways to Net Zero - AWARD
description:
West Oxfordshire District Council and Cherwell District Council are district local authorities. Both authorities have dedicated climate change teams who work collaboratively on net zero projects. 
      
      Both authorities have contributed to and endorsed the Oxfordshire Net Zero Route Map and Action Plan. This report presents a 'leading the way' pathway to net zero and identifies workstreams for Oxfordshire local authorities to develop collaboratively to provide a catalyst for positive action across the region. District-specific targets are noted, Cherwell references 2030 and West Oxfordshire 2050; however, the route map modelling focuses on an Oxfordshire-wide net zero by 2050. The Future Oxfordshire Strategic Vision aims for countywide net zero to be achieved by 2040.

title: Young People Supported Accommodation - Ages 18+ - Cherwell and City
description:
Oxfordshire County Council is seeking to procure a service for accommodation and support for young people aged 18 plus, in the Cherwell and City districts of Oxfordshire.

Our Vision is that every child and young person in Oxfordshire should have access to a full range of housing services and the opportunity for a decent and affordable home suitable to their needs; and that vulnerable families should be enabled to live in safe and suitable housing as a basis for supportive family relationships and thriving communities.

The Objectives of the YPSA are for Young People:
To be in accommodation suitable for their needs
To be supported to maintain their accommodation appropriately
To feel safe and are protected from harm
To engage in education, employment and training
To be supported to live healthier lives
To be equipped with the skills necessary to live independently.
To be supported to prevent homelessness / reoccurrence of homelessness
To be supported to build appropriate and positive relationships and links to their local communities and family members (where it is safe)
To be moved on in a planned manner, without reoccurrence of homelessness

This service is being co-commissioned in partnership with the City Council and Cherwell District Council, with Oxfordshire County Council (OCC) as the Lead Commissioner which reflects the close working relationship and commitment between OCC and City and District Councils to jointly deliver these services for vulnerable young people.

description:
UKSPF Green Skills Contract 

The Council seeks proposals from organisations with the capabilities, experience, capacity and local networks to deliver a bespoke project to 31st March 2025.  
This project should provide residents and businesses operating within Cherwell with the opportunity to gain a green skills qualification through a bespoke package of fully subsidised training places for residents and businesses. 
The project should deliver a wide range of courses to support the net zero transition and maximise the opportunities it presents. 
The project could also look to support businesses in other sectors to adapt to the net-zero transition and embed low carbon practices within their organisation. Courses and training for supervisors, managers and those in strategic positions could be offered to assist them in identifying and maximising opportunities to shift towards low carbon modes of operation.

title: Panel of Suppliers for the Provisions of Floor Coverings - Supply and Fit - AWARD
description:
Bromford is pleased to invite flooring suppliers to submit bids for the Provision of Flooring Services to meet the growing requirements of Bromford Flagship. The organisation is seeking a minimum of fifteen experienced flooring contractors, with three contractors per locality area, subject to sufficient bidders meeting Bromford's minimum standards, to support its expanding geographical footprint. Three flooring providers will be selected for each area.
      
      The areas covered for the works will include:
      Locality Area 1 - Staffordshire and the Marches (to include but not limited to, Stoke on Trent, Newcastle Under Lyme, Stafford, Telford & The Wrekin, Shropshire, Lichfield, Bromsgrove)
      Locality Area 2 - Central ( to include but not limited to, Birmingham, Wolverhampton, Walsall, Daventry, Cherwell, Oxfordshire)
      Locality Area 3 - Gloucestershire (to include but not limited to, Gloucester, Tewkesbury, Cheltenham, Forest of Dean, Cotswolds)
      Locality Area 4	 - West of England (to include but not limited to, South Gloucestershire, Wiltshire, Swindon, Bristol, North Somerset)
      Locality Area 5 - East of England (to include but not limited to, Norfolk, Suffolk, Essex, Cambridgeshire and adjoining counties)

title: Consultancy and Advisory Services for Health
description:
NHS Shared Business Services act in an Agency capacity for and on behalf of its customers (Approved Organisations) - existing and new. These comprise of NHS and Social Care organisations (whether acting individually, or on behalf of, or together as members of any consortia) along with any other public or private sector bodies which NHS SBS authorises to use the resulting Framework/Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS).
NHS Shared Business Services Limited (NHS SBS) has put in place a Framework Agreement for the provision of Consultancy and Advisory Services for Health and related Services for Healthcare to be used by NHS SBS Approved Organisations. 

https://www.sbs.nhs.uk/services/framework-agreements-categories/ 

The framework includes;  
Lot 1 - Business, Leadership, Management, Governance, Structure & Strategy
Lot 2 - Integrated Care, Healthcare & Community care
Lot 3 - Commercialisation, Innovation & Transformation
Lot 4 - Communications, Engagement & Research
Lot 5 - IT Business Consultancy
Lot 6 - Finance and Procurement
Lot 7 - HR and Employment, Skills, and Training
Lot 8 - Disease Outbreaks - Endemics, Epidemics and Pandemics
Lot 9 - Social Value, Sustainability, and Carbon Neutrality
Lot 10 - Property
